notes: Triggers when 8+ grey nomads are within 12 tiles of the player after sleep 1, or immediately under #mg hash. Entry dims the world to 60% over ~240ms, then the encounter runs. The flame (drawn above the player) decays at 1.8/frame and brightens +18 on left-click; the target band drifts sinusoidally (50±8). Nomads approach when the flame is in-band (±12 of target), freeze when out-of-band. Win: all nomads reach r=30 and t>1s → converts 3 greys to devout, burns 2 tribe members. Fail: flame >85 (white flash) or <15 (gutter) → 4 tribe members grey out. The encounter owns the click (returns early in onClick) so feeding the flame does not also trigger the Flame verb. WASD still moves the avatar during the encounter (no freeze on player_pos). Resolution applies effects then clears MG.active and restores dim_alpha to 0, returning control.
